_doc: Your game's clip set and movement speed. Read by tools/charkit_pack.py (charpack/bake presets and the game-speed checks) and by character specs (import it to set walk speed). See AGENTS.md 'Calibrate game speed' and 'Clip profile'. These values are OUR game's (a top-down social-deduction game); replace them with yours. tools/gamespeed.py computes the game block from your sprite numbers.
name: example: Clocktower (social deduction, top-down town)

clipNotes.idle: alive but calm; <= 4 drawings, extremes held >= 30 grid frames (loop 72)
clipNotes.walk: THE in-game locomotion at the game speed below; the species' own gait
clipNotes.talk: speaking loop: mouth opens >= 2 texels + a hand/head beat >= 25 deg every 8-14 grid frames
clipNotes.vote: raise hand/wing/paw (or a prop) above the head in <= 6 grid frames and HOLD
clipNotes.point: the shared emote: aim an arm at someone, hold >= 24 grid frames, return
clipNotes.die: gentle, non-violent collapse to a held pose that reads as 'down' at 25 %
clipNotes.ghost: dead player: pale, hovering loop (spec.ghost draws the look)
clipNotes.ghost-spent: ghost after its one vote: dimmer, head bowed, no halo
clipNotes.$emote: ONE signature social emote from the brief (spec.emote names the clip)

game.source: 150 px/s player speed, ~38 px tall sprites, 4-drawing walk at ~12.5 fps -> 3.95 body-heights/s, cycle 0.32 s, 1.26 H per cycle
